validation.name: Accessibility structure rubric

validation.name: GrowthLab localized onboarding

validation.name: Localized measurement panel
validation.detail: Chrome switched the measurement panel to Spanish and Arabic; translated headings, source states and controls rendered, Arabic set dir=rtl, viewport width stayed fitted and no browser warnings or errors were recorded

validation.name: GrowthLab settings panel
validation.detail: Chrome opened the anchored settings surface, switched the theme to dark and restored the system preference; the rendered layout stayed within the viewport and browser logs remained empty
